translations.web: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
translations.bsb: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
